title: Convergent Linear Representations of Emergent Misalignment

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting a semantically-specific 'gender' misalignment direction from model activations and scoring generated responses for sexism, gender roles, and stereotypes using a targeted GPT-4o LLM judge.
Using a 'Bad Stuff' LLM judge to evaluate open-ended model responses for the presence of dangerous or immoral topics, which explicitly includes 'themes of bias'.
